question_stem:
A child sits on the ground next to a remote-controlled toy car. At time $t = 0$, the car begins to move in a straight line directly away from the child. The variation with time $t$ of the velocity of the car along this line is shown in Fig. 4.1.

{{figure:9702_w21_22_q04_figure_4_1}}

Fig. 4.1

The car's horn continually emits sound of frequency $925\text{ Hz}$ between time $t = 0$ and time $t = 6.0\text{ s}$. The speed of the sound in the air is $338\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.part_stem: Describe qualitatively the variation, if any, in the frequency of the sound heard, by the child, that was emitted from the car horn:

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: from time $t = 4.0\text{ s}$ to time $t = 6.0\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Determine the frequency, to three significant figures, of the sound heard, by the child, that was emitted from the car horn at time $t = 3.0\text{ s}$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Determine the time taken for the sound emitted at time $t = 4.0\text{ s}$ to travel to the child.
